title: Reinforcement Learning of Contact Preferability in Multi-Contact Locomotion Planning for Humanoids
title_zh: 人形机器人多接触运动规划中接触偏好性的强化学习
abstract: In this letter, we propose the multi-contact locomotion planning framework for humanoid robots that leverages the target contact selection considering its long-term preferability by reinforcement learning (RL) in optimization-based motion generation with feasibility constraints. It is difficult to predict how the next target contact will affect the motion of the robot over the future in multi-contact locomotion, where humanoid robots are required to perform complex motions with kinematic constraints and static equilibrium. To solve this problem, we evaluate the preferability of the motion planned by the optimization-based motion planner to reach the target contact, which we define as contact preferability, as the reward for RL. This idea enabled us to train the policy to provide a contact with the large future preferability without explicitly designing its future promise by ourselves. We also propose the design of action space for RL based on the robot's reachability. We construct sets of feasible joint angles for each limb of the robot as successors and use them as the action space instead of directly managing contact poses. By defining the deterministic mapping from the successor to the target contact, the proposed framework can manage acyclic multi-contact motion where the number of contacts can be changed. We evaluate the proposed framework in three scenarios and prove that it can plan a preferable contact sequence for multi-contact locomotion with a high success rate and short computational time.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种人形机器人多接触运动规划框架，该框架在基于优化的运动生成中，通过强化学习（RL）考虑目标接触的长期偏好性来进行目标接触选择。在多接触运动中，人形机器人需要在运动学约束和静态平衡下执行复杂动作，因此难以预测下一个目标接触将如何影响机器人未来的运动。为了解决这个问题，我们将基于优化的运动规划器为到达目标接触所规划的运动偏好性（我们定义为接触偏好性）作为RL的奖励进行评估。这一想法使我们能够训练策略来提供具有大未来偏好性的接触，而无需自己显式设计其未来前景。我们还提出了基于机器人可达性的RL动作空间设计。我们为机器人的每个肢体构建可行关节角集合作为后继，并使用它们作为动作空间，而不是直接管理接触位姿。通过定义从后继到目标接触的确定性映射，所提出的框架可以管理接触数量可变的非循环多接触运动。我们在三个场景中评估了所提出的框架，并证明它可以以高成功率和短计算时间为多接触运动规划出优选的接触序列。
tldr_zh: 提出强化学习选择接触偏好性的多接触运动规划框架。
cover_zh: 人形机器人多接触运动｜用强化学习选接触点，规划成功率超高！
